scope_statement: Profiles linking forward to the Research Academy.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to any external site, including the bodies this page points readers to. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline.
claims_needing_verification: Knee research is done by clinical groups, biomechanics laboratories, imaging groups and engineers.
Most of it is clinics, data and long follow up rather than laboratory bench work.
Many knee researchers are not doctors.
Statistics is the tool the whole field depends on.
Carrying out one small project is the most useful preparation available at school.
claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the key learning points. Most statements on this page are about United Kingdom education, training or examination structures rather than about clinical matters, and each is checkable against the body named in the page's final section.
content_rule: Decision 003: this page carries no entry requirement, test score, fee, deadline or application statistic. A reviewer who wants figures on the page should add them with a dated source rather than asking for them to be written in.
